en.headline: Hong Kong and Uzbekistan sign gold market cooperation pact
en.dek: Christopher Hui exchanged an MOU with Uzbekistan’s central bank at the Belt and Road Summit; the two sides were due to meet again on Thursday.
body: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Christopher Hui, exchanged a memorandum of understanding with Abror Mirzo Olimov, deputy chairman of the Central Bank of Uzbekistan, at the Belt and Road Summit on Wednesday, the government said.

The government said the document sets a framework for Hong Kong’s financial platform and precious-metals infrastructure to work with Uzbekistan as a major gold-producing and reserve-holding country. The sides will share information on gold and precious-metals markets, study services of the Hong Kong Precious Metals Central Clearing Company Limited’s gold clearing system, and examine whether the Uzbek central bank might take part in precious-metals activity in Hong Kong through that company.

Hui said the national 15th Five-Year Plan outline supports Hong Kong in building a commodity trading ecosystem, and described the memorandum as a concrete step with a Belt and Road partner. The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau was scheduled to hold a bilateral meeting with the Uzbek central bank on Thursday to discuss the plans in the document. Hui also co-chaired a roundtable on Wednesday with Uzbekistan’s prime minister and Hong Kong financial and business representatives.

zh.headline: 港與烏茲別克簽備忘錄加強黃金市場合作
zh.dek: 許正宇周三在一帶一路高峰論壇與烏茲別克央行副主席交換諒解備忘錄，財庫局周四續開雙邊會議。
body: 政府表示，財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇周三在一帶一路高峰論壇，與烏茲別克中央銀行副主席Abror Mirzo Olimov交換諒解備忘錄，加強兩地黃金市場合作。
當局指備忘錄訂出框架，結合香港國際化金融平台及貴金屬市場基建，與烏茲別克作為主要黃金生產及儲備地的優勢。雙方將就黃金及貴金屬市場交換資訊和經驗、研究港金結算公司黃金中央清算及結算系統的服務，以及烏茲別克央行經該公司參與香港貴金屬業務的機遇。
許正宇表示，國家「十五五」規劃綱要支持香港構建大宗商品交易生態圈，備忘錄是與一帶一路夥伴落實有關策略的具體一步。財庫局原定周四與烏茲別克央行舉行雙邊會議，跟進備忘錄內容。許正宇周三亦與烏茲別克總理共同主持圓桌會議，會見本港金融及企業代表。
